{{Top|leg}}
A '''stun charge''' was an electrical shock emitted by a [[shock-filament]]. A person stepping on a shock-filament would suffer from a intense electrical charge, sufficient enough to pass through any footwear&mdash;insulated or otherwise&mdash;into the offender. The charge was powerful enough to render a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] unconscious, and repeated shocks could kill a [[Human/Legends|Human]].

[[Xufal D'uat]] adapted cells in his ship, [[Twi'lek Dancer|''Venom Sting'']], with shock-filaments that could unleash stun charges on his prisoners. This customization was to the liking of later owners of the ship, a team of [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]].
